{{Quote|It'll take more than the likes of you to stop me.|Yansu Grjak|<ref name="JA">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''</ref>}}
'''Yansu Grjak''' was a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We will not repeat the mistakes of Shaman Yansu Grjak, who too eagerly sold the services of her clan to Separatist buyers and then could not protect her sisters from the Jedi counterattack.|Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="Book of Sith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Yansuru.png|thumb|left|200px|Yansu and two of her Nightsisters]]
Yansu was a [[shaman of the Nightsisters]] who lived during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> She and her fellow sister [[Sai Sircu]] led an army of their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding followers at the beginning of the war between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], after abandoning their homeworld, [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] due to leadership disputes with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. At that time, they formed an alliance with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in order to bring about the downfall of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="JA" />

During the conflict, she encountered two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who attempted to fight her. Grjak thus sent her fellow Nightsisters against the Jedi, allowing herself to flee in a [[Scimitar/Legends|Sith Infiltrator]] ship.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

Later she was sent to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], where she was [[Battle of Rodia (Clone Wars)|chased]] down by a pair of Jedi, and despite her powers, she was killed by the pair, weakened by crystals being thrown at her by the Jedi via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
